By: Kate Barry | Paid

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We expose the dance academy that groomed children for sex

Unique Selling Point:
An expose of the the Tebogo Kgobokoe Arts Academy in Lanseria. The well-known national dance champion and star of Strictly Come Dancing and Dancing With the Stars runs a private school. There are 30 students aged between 8 and 18 who board on the premises. Four former learners have stepped forward to tell the public how they were groomed by the Deputy Principal and her husband to have sex with the boys.

Summary:
The school follows the 3-term Cambridge curriculum. They are only allowed to go home at half-term, meaning they spend most weekends at school. According to the girls, when the school was at the Brits campus (2017 - 2018) Tebogo Kgobokoe's sister - Tlamelo Nalumango (Aunty Penny) and her husband, Lulu Nalumango (Uncle Lulu) - would run a sex ring which they called The Game. There were 3 boys involved (all under age) Lolwazi, Ofentse and Moeketse. They would then choose 3 girls who they wanted to sleep with. The Big Six were then taken to the Nalumango's 3-bedroom townhouse in Hartebeespoort Dam (53/54 Caribbean Beach Club)for the weekend. There they would be shown porn videos and each couple were given a room for the night. Other girls were encouraged to join the group and on a Friday each student was told to write down the name of the girl/boy they wanted to have sex with. Aunty Penny would then decide who came home for the weekend. She often told them "This is natural; it's part of life; it's your choice." Aunty Penny presented herself as the school psychologist and nurse, and taught the students French, Maths, Science and Afrikaans. As far as we can ascertain the school is registered with the British International College, but not with the Gauteng Department of Education as required by all independent schools

Further information:
The school's best dancer, B, was 11 when she went to the TKAA. She too was brought into the Game and encouraged to have sex with Ofentse and then Lolwazi. By the age of 13 she was pregnant. Aunt Penny asked the students to get R500 for a pill to terminate the pregnancy. She was over 3 months pregnant when her waters broke and she aborted twins in the school toilet. Aunt Penny was there and helped her to flush the first foetus down the toilet. Lolwazi (the father and a twin himself) was there when the second foetus aborted. B confided in her mother that two other girls Jade and Cassidy, also fell pregnant and Aunt Penny facilitated the termination. (B's mother was sworn to secrecy, but Cassidy's mother confirmed this. Jade's mother does not know)
When another girl, 14-year-old Dipulelo, was suspended for smoking weed in 2018, she told her mother that she wanted to be expelled from the school so she didn't have to be part of the sex ring anymore. Her mother laid a charge at FCS, but the inspector could not corroborate her story. According to Jade and Cassidy, Aunt Penny told all the students to deny the allegations. The Nalumangos were then fired and left Harties before SAPS could search their townhouse. All three boys are still at the school, as are some of the girls who have been involved for years. (Joy, Vanessa, Surprise, Khwazi - Lolwazi's twin sister)
When Cassidy and jade finally told their mothers what had happened in January 2019, they also laid charges at FCS. The docket is now with Advocate Molatudi, the Acting Chief Prosecutor of DPP North Gauteng.

metadata.Unique Selling Point: An expose of the the Tebogo Kgobokoe Arts Academy in Lanseria. The well-known national dance champion and star of Strictly Come Dancing and Dancing With the Stars runs a private school. There are 30 students aged between 8 and 18 who board on the premises. Four former learners have stepped forward to tell the public how they were groomed by the Deputy Principal and her husband to have sex with the boys.
metadata.Summary: The school follows the 3-term Cambridge curriculum. They are only allowed to go home at half-term, meaning they spend most weekends at school. According to the girls, when the school was at the Brits campus (2017 - 2018) Tebogo Kgobokoe's sister - Tlamelo Nalumango (Aunty Penny) and her husband, Lulu Nalumango (Uncle Lulu) - would run a sex ring which they called The Game. There were 3 boys involved (all under age) Lolwazi, Ofentse and Moeketse. They would then choose 3 girls who they wanted to sleep with. The Big Six were then taken to the Nalumango's 3-bedroom townhouse in Hartebeespoort Dam (53/54 Caribbean Beach Club)for the weekend. There they would be shown porn videos and each couple were given a room for the night. Other girls were encouraged to join the group and on a Friday each student was told to write down the name of the girl/boy they wanted to have sex with. Aunty Penny would then decide who came home for the weekend. She often told them "This is natural; it's part of life; it's your choice." Aunty Penny presented herself as the school psychologist and nurse, and taught the students French, Maths, Science and Afrikaans. As far as we can ascertain the school is registered with the British International College, but not with the Gauteng Department of Education as required by all independent schools
metadata.Further information: The school's best dancer, B, was 11 when she went to the TKAA. She too was brought into the Game and encouraged to have sex with Ofentse and then Lolwazi. By the age of 13 she was pregnant. Aunt Penny asked the students to get R500 for a pill to terminate the pregnancy. She was over 3 months pregnant when her waters broke and she aborted twins in the school toilet. Aunt Penny was there and helped her to flush the first foetus down the toilet. Lolwazi (the father and a twin himself) was there when the second foetus aborted. B confided in her mother that two other girls Jade and Cassidy, also fell pregnant and Aunt Penny facilitated the termination. (B's mother was sworn to secrecy, but Cassidy's mother confirmed this. Jade's mother does not know) When another girl, 14-year-old Dipulelo, was suspended for smoking weed in 2018, she told her mother that she wanted to be expelled from the school so she didn't have to be part of the sex ring anymore. Her mother laid a charge at FCS, but the inspector could not corroborate her story. According to Jade and Cassidy, Aunt Penny told all the students to deny the allegations. The Nalumangos were then fired and left Harties before SAPS could search their townhouse. All three boys are still at the school, as are some of the girls who have been involved for years. (Joy, Vanessa, Surprise, Khwazi - Lolwazi's twin sister) When Cassidy and jade finally told their mothers what had happened in January 2019, they also laid charges at FCS. The docket is now with Advocate Molatudi, the Acting Chief Prosecutor of DPP North Gauteng.
